text: Lighting forms the foundation of strong photography by defining both detail and atmosphere. When a scene is brightly illuminated, it invites viewer interpretation; conversely, heavy shadows often induce feelings of tension or anxiety. A tripod provides stability to preserve light levels and eliminate motion blur caused by camera shake. Achieving sharpness requires disciplined compositional practice alongside specific techniques such as panning and tracking. Furthermore, focusing on these elements underscores focal points and builds a unified visual story.
